# Routed Gothic (SIL OFL 1.1)

The app's headline face, by Darren Embry: the lettering of drawing templates and
engraved panels. `routed-gothic.ttf` is the unmodified regular style from
<https://github.com/dse/routed-gothic> (`dist/ttf/`); the licence is in `OFL.txt`.

`apps/web/src/fonts/routed-gothic.woff2` is the same font compressed with `ttf2woff2`,
with no glyph changes. The app leaves the digits to its text face (the font draws 1 as a
bare stroke and 0 as a round O): see `unicode-range` in its `styles.css`.
